## Projects

The most important assignments this semester are the three projects. 

- The [Project A page](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-projectA-2026/) provides instructions and materials related to Project A.
- The [Project B page](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-projectB-2026/) provides Project B instructions and materials.
- The [Project C page](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-projectC-2026/) provides Project C instructions and materials.

- Project deadlines are specified on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd). 

## Labs

The [Lab page](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-labs-2026) links to instructions and materials for each of the seven lab assignments. 

- Lab deadlines are specified on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd). 

## Minute Papers

The [Minute Papers page](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-minute-2026) provides links to all Minute Paper assignments and feedback documents.

- Minute Paper deadlines are also specified on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd). 

## Quizzes

Professor Love will set several "Quizzes" these semester. 

- These "Quizzes" might better be described as "check ins": brief opportunities for you to demonstrate your understanding and how well you're keeping up with the course. 
- Quiz details will be provided as they appear during the semester, **rather** than in advance, so you **won't** find them on the Course Calendar.

## For More Information

Our [Syllabus](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-syllabus-2026/) provides additional information on [assignments](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-syllabus-2026/10_assignments.html) and on how the course is [graded](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-syllabus-2026/11_grading.html).
